propositions: Close dispatches the completion verifier unconditionally even when the ticket already carries a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS bound to the exact immutable commit being closed.

The close precheck and auto-resume seams do not consult the ticket's existing completion attestation before invoking the provider, despite signature infrastructure already authenticating the stored record.
A close operation at the exact SHA of a valid stored completion PASS should reuse that attestation and make zero provider calls instead of redundantly re-verifying.

Reuse eligibility requires the completion op-cert to be cryptographically verified with authenticated SHA pin, material fingerprint, and PASS status all matching the current close target and ticket state.
Attestations invalidated by later reopens, changed refs, missing fingerprints, material drift, or unverifiable signatures must fall through to fresh verification.
The reuse check must be inserted at the close auto-resume seam before provider dispatch while preserving the existing locked close and post-close signing path for all cases.
